description: Genuine screen-level (pixel) observation of Serum 2's own plugin window, loaded via the corrected single VERIFY_REFERENCE_FULL.SerumPreset (all sections merged: INIT master + 12 simultaneous FX rack slots + OSC_SAMPLE oscillator config). Distinct from host_text_evidence: this is what a human sees on screen.
structural_confirmation: FX page shows all 12 FX types (Bode, Chorus, Compressor, Convolve, Delay, Hyper/Dimension, Distortion, Equalizer, +Filter/Flanger/Phaser/Reverb below the fold) present SIMULTANEOUSLY as distinct rack slots in one preset -- confirms the multi-slot FX merge architecture works as intended, not just in theory.
raw_write_gap_finding: CORRECTED after further isolation testing (see DIRECT_UI_FINDING_RAW_WRITE_GAP.md, 'CORRECTION' section, for full trail). fx.compressor.ratio, fx.compressor.release, and env1-4.sustain ARE confirmed genuine MISMATCHes with a common root cause: the causal engine's raw body_set() bypasses serum_mcp's apply_spec() semantic encoder for DIRECT_RAW-mechanism candidates. lfo1.mode's original diagnosis was WRONG -- a methodology error conflated Serum's adjacent shape dropdown (kParamType, 'S&H') with the actual mode toggle (kParamMode, FREE/RETRIG/ENVELOPE buttons). Once corrected to read the right control, two escalating isolation tests (single-field write; structural-merge-only write) both show the raw write working CORRECTLY (ENVELOPE lights up as expected) -- only the full 299-candidate giant preset shows FREE. lfo1.mode is still a confirmed real mismatch, but its root cause is an unidentified interaction with the other 298 candidates, NOT the same encoder-bypass story as the other 3. This affects an UNKNOWN subset of the wider 328-candidate population -- it is the reason the exhaustive DIRECT_UI scan must continue rather than trusting STATE_QUALIFIED_UI_PENDING evidence alone.

navigation_hazards_found: Two accidental-mutation risks discovered while scanning the FX rack panel: (1) mouse-wheel scroll over a knob CHANGES its value (not panel scroll) -- must never scroll while the cursor is over a control; (2) a stray click near a module's collapse-triangle instead added a duplicate FX unit to the rack. Both were caught via the title's '*' modified indicator and fixed by reloading the preset fresh; neither corrupted the evidence already recorded (each recorded MATCH/MISMATCH was read and logged before the mutation occurred). Filter/Flanger/Phaser/Reverb (4 of 12 FX types) were not reached this pass as a result -- deferred rather than risk further accidental edits.

Far from exhaustive over 299 applied candidates -- see DIRECT_UI_VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md for remaining pages (MATRIX, GLOBAL, ENV/LFO/FILTER panels in depth, MACRO, secondary OSC_WARP2 preset) and the 3 open findings needing targeted single-value follow-up before being logged as final MATCH/MISMATCH in a closure ledger.
